abilities.name: Barbed Strike
abilities.text: Until the end of this fighter's activation, if an attack action made by this fighter scores any hits or critical hits, subtract 1 from the target fighter's Toughness characteristic (to a minimum of 1) until the end of the battle round.

abilities.name: Chain Garrotte
abilities.text: Pick a visible enemy fighter within 5" of this fighter and roll a dice. On a roll of 3-4, allocate 1 damage point to that fighter. On a roll of 5+, allocate a number of damage points to that fighter equal to the value of this ability.

abilities.name: Nightmarish Visage
abilities.text: Pick an enemy fighter within a number of inches of this fighter equal to the value of this ability and roll a dice. On a roll of 3+, until the end of the battle round, that fighter cannot make move actions or disengage actions.

abilities.name: Flaying Frenzy
abilities.text: Roll a dice for each visible enemy fighter within 3" of this fighter. On a roll of 3-4, allocate 1 damage point to the fighter being rolled for. On a roll of 5+, allocate a number of damage points to the fighter being rolled for equal to the value of this ability.

abilities.name: Vessel of Torment
abilities.text: A fighter can only use this ability if an enemy fighter has been taken down by an attack action made by them this activation. This fighter can make a bonus move action. Then, this fighter can make a bonus attack action.

abilities.name: Gift of Agony
abilities.text: This fighter makes a bonus attack action. Add 3 to the Strength and Attacks characteristics of that attack action if this fighter has 1 or more damage points allocated to them.

abilities.name: Shared Pain
abilities.text: A fighter can make this reaction after they are targeted by a melee attack action but before the hit rolls are made. For each hit roll from that attack action that hits, allocate 1 damage point to the attacking fighter. For each critical hit, allocate 2 damage points to the attacking fighter instead.

abilities.name: Shared Bliss
abilities.text: Once per battle, after an enemy fighter is taken down by the damage points allocated by the 'Shared Pain' reaction, roll a dice. On a 3+, you gain a [quad] ability dice with a value of 1.
